title: Launching Our Next-Generation Insights Platform
summary: Our powerful new tool, previously available in beta, is now officially launched, empowering you with advanced capabilities for smarter decision-making.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: We've launched an intuitive file management system that gives you complete control over your embedded content, allowing you to easily upload, remove, download, and customize how files are displayed within your editor.

title: Discover Our Dynamic Product Roadmap
summary: Stay informed about our latest developments and future plans with our new, easy-to-navigate public product roadmap.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a smoother workflow with our enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, perfectly blending with our modern design.

title: Elevated Collaboration Experience
summary: We've made teamwork smoother and more intuitive, so you can collaborate with greater awareness and ease within the editor.

title: Seamless Collaboration and Shared Discoveries
summary: Experience enhanced collaboration and discovery with improved visibility and utility for all your shared items, making teamwork more seamless than ever.

title: Global Language Accessibility
summary: We are expanding Noeko's reach by adding support for multiple international languages, making it accessible to users worldwide.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We're thrilled to open Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's exciting evolution.

title: Intelligent Constellation View
summary: Navigate your entire knowledge base with enhanced precision by applying powerful filters for tags, time, and shared items within the intelligent Constellation View.

title: Smart Search and Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Revolutionize how you find and organize information by leveraging advanced search filters, flexible sorting, and the power to save your tailored results as custom knowledge collections.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: Experience a more intuitive and dynamic way to organize and view your notes, making your connections clearer and more engaging.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosted Freedom, Powerful Paid Plans
summary: Noeko now offers enhanced flexibility with new self-hosting options and powerful paid plans, empowering you to deploy and scale on your terms.

title: Elevate Your Style with New & Improved Themes
summary: We're enhancing your experience with beautifully refined existing themes and a vibrant collection of exciting new designs, offering unparalleled personalization.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're refining our app's greetings to precisely match the time of day, ensuring a more welcoming and accurate user experience for everyone.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage multiple tagged items by performing actions like unapplying tags and deleting entries directly from the tag view, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in and interact with content from YouTube, websites, text files, and more, empowering you to consolidate all your valuable information in one place.
